english.title: Remove seal skins from place of importation with intent to evade prohibition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[removed]_
(B)_[assisted in the removal of]_
(C)_[were concerned in the removal of]_

seal skins, the commercial importation of which was prohibited by virtue of regulation 2 of the Import of Seal Skins Regulations 1996, from

(D)_[their place of importation]_
(E)_[an approved wharf]_
(F)_[an examination station]_
(G)_[a transit shed]_
(H)_[a customs and excise station]_

at **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE OF REMOVAL..), with intent to evade the prohibition
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(2)(b), (4) and (5B) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
